decisions.reason: This product is closely related to the firm’s existing glass packaging and substrate know-how, so with its strong in-house R&D and research cooperation it is well placed to learn from early market feedback and improve the offer rather than exit it.

This laser-based structuring offer builds directly on the firm’s core processing capabilities and strategic move toward higher-value semiconductor applications, and its prominent 2024 presentation suggests the firm has both the knowledge base and commitment to develop it further.
